name: Sentinel
title: Even Court sentinel
examine: Old blood, keeping a waystone where the lamps stop. The thread across the dying stand is theirs, their light draws nothing, and the old tongue is not going to be explained.
lines: The thread is cut in four places. The fourth is new.
Step over it. Cutting it is the thing you should not do, and you already know that, or you would not have asked.
The wolves walk it. Nothing else does. That is the count.
